blocks.purpose: A block that carries a quorum commitment (qcTx) next to its coinbase cbTx
An old block from before DIP-3 (no cbTx): its height comes from the BIP-34 push in the coinbase script

txs.purpose: A normal transaction with 9 inputs and 9 outputs, InstantSend-locked and ChainLocked, so prevouts and the lock flags both show
A coinbase transaction (block reward, no prevouts)
A classic coinbase from before DIP-3: no payload, one input, two outputs
A coinbase with a CbTx payload (merkle roots, best ChainLock, credit pool balance)
A ProUpServTx: a masternode service update
A ProUpRegTx: a masternode registrar update
An AssetLockTx: Core funds locked to credit a Platform identity
An AssetUnlockTx: a Platform withdrawal paying out on Core
